description: This file defines the DepositPreClosureDetail class, which encapsulates the details related to pre-closure penalties for a deposit in a banking or financial software system. It includes fields for whether a penalty is applicable, the penalty interest amount, and the type of interest application. The class provides methods for creating instances, updating data via commands, and copying instances.

classes.name: DepositPreClosureDetail
classes.description: A class representing the details of pre-closure penalties for a deposit, including applicability, amount, and type. It includes methods for creating, updating, and copying instances.
